newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin plans vacation after Germany trip-Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin plans vacation after Germany trip-Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will take two weeks vacation after his visit to Germany from April 16-18, the presidential press service said on Wednesday.

A Kremlin spokesman said Yeltsin would travel to the Black Sea resort of Sochi. Yeltsin, sidelined with heart problems and then pneumonia for most of the second half of last year and for some of this year, often travels to Sochi in the spring.

The Kremlin said Yeltsin, 66, will break off his vacation at the end of this month to meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin in Moscow. Ministers will also travel to Sochi to meet the Russian president during his vacation.

Yeltsin has been stepping up his workload steadily since he recovered from pneumonia and he has had a series of meetings with foreign leaders, including a summit meeting with U.S. President Bill Clinton in Helsinki last month.
He is to address Russians on the radio on Thursday, dealing with the problem of corruption and the need to strengthen state power in Russia.
